provider: U.S. Geological Survey (USGS) 3D Elevation Program / The National Map (TNMAccess)
api_version: TNM Access API v1 / USGS Seamless 1-Meter (S1M) DEM, DOI 10.5066/P13LJKFS

request_contract.parameter_rules: DOCUMENTATION ONLY. Discovery MUST identify USGS TNM dataset tag 'Seamless 1-m DEM (S1M)' from the official datasets catalogue and not infer or silently substitute older project-based 1-meter DEM, OPR DEM, 1/3 arc-second, 1/9 arc-second, LiDAR LAZ or a generic 1-meter result. A subsequent separately approved trusted metadata probe would query a single frozen S1M dataset and one fixed small bounding box with max=1 and offset=0. Until explicit T1 approval reject caller-supplied host, dataset alias, coordinates, product ID, URL, parameters, pagination, download link and redirects. Catalogues may return a product download URL; do not dereference it under this contract.

response_contract.format: USGS TNM Access API v1 JSON dataset catalogue and product search metadata only; no GeoTIFF or source point-cloud bytes.
response_contract.scientific_semantics: The S1M is a newer 1-meter bare-earth DEM compiled from many LiDAR projects and published in 10-km COG tiles with pixel-level source lineage. Distinct from project-based 1-meter DEM, it has incomplete and expanding coverage; advertised 1-meter pixel spacing does not imply one-meter vertical accuracy. Elevation represents terrain rather than building roof or finished-floor height; horizontal CRS, vertical datum/epoch, survey vintage, blending and source work-unit quality must be verified before hydrologic or building-overlap use.

operational_constraints.rate_limit_notes: No network requests are approved by this documentation-only contract. Later T1 approval must specify one bounded metadata request and fixed AOI, max=1, offset=0, no automatic pagination or directory traversal, no GeoTIFF transfer, retry, schedule or bulk harvesting.
operational_constraints.mutability_notes: USGS TNM catalogue is continuously updated. Freeze discovery UTC, exact query, resolved sbDatasetTag, dataset and product IDs, full provider metadata URLs, any tile reference/filename, response byte count and SHA-256. The full original COG would require a separately approved exact-byte retrieval receipt and independent raster validity/datum checks.

rights_and_policy.notes: USGS explicitly lists 3DEP products as public domain and makes S1M freely accessible; the S1M Science Data Catalog release DOI is 10.5066/P13LJKFS. This dataset-level rights evidence does not automatically establish the permitted load/rate conditions for TNMAccess services or legal status of every possible downstream ancillary layer; the machine interface and any eventual automated acquisition must be reviewed separately. No rights promotion from public-domain science data to unattended API automation or model admission.

notes: Bounded interface description only. This does not prove any S1M tile is available in a requested county, and no provider DEM, catalogue response bytes or finished-floor elevations have been acquired or staged. S1M must be distinguished from USGS older project-based 1-meter DEM and from high-resolution building roof products. No CAT model admission, insurer attribution, coverage selection or Neon write is authorized.
